title: 并联电容提高功率因数：求 C
statement: 感性负载接在 U = 220 V（有效值）、f = 50 Hz 的电源上，吸收有功功率 P = 10 kW，功率因数 cos φ₁ = 0.6（滞后）。
现在负载两端并联电容 C，把电源端的功率因数提高到 cos φ₂ = 0.9（仍为滞后）。求：负载电流、电容需提供的无功功率、所需电容（以容抗表示）和补偿后的电源电流。

questions.explain: I_Z = P/(U cos φ₁) = 10000/(220 × 0.6) ≈ 75.76 A。并联电容不改变负载的电压，所以负载电流补偿前后不变。

questions.ask: 电容吸收的无功功率 Q_C = ?
questions.explain: 补偿前 Q₁ = P tan φ₁ = 10000 × 4/3 = 13333 var，补偿后 Q₂ = P tan φ₂ = 10000 × 0.4843 = 4843 var，Q_C = Q₂ − Q₁ = −P(tan φ₁ − tan φ₂) ≈ −8490 var。

questions.ask: 所需电容的容抗 X_C = 1/(ωC) = ?（由此可得 C）
补偿后电源电流有效值 I = ?
questions.explain: 有功不变：I = P/(U cos φ₂) = 10000/(220 × 0.9) ≈ 50.51 A，比补偿前的 75.76 A 小了三分之一。

hints: 并联电容不改变负载的电压、电流和有功功率 P，只改变电源提供的无功功率。
补偿前后的无功分别是 P tan φ₁ 和 P tan φ₂，差值由电容提供。
solution: **1. 负载电流。** I_Z = P/(U cos φ₁) = 10000/132 ≈ **75.76 A**（补偿前这也是电源电流）。
Q₁ = P tan φ₁ ≈ 13333 var，Q₂ = P tan φ₂ ≈ 4843 var，电容吸收 Q_C = Q₂ − Q₁ ≈ **−8490 var**（即提供 8490 var）。
提高功率因数的意义：负载的工作状态不变，而线路电流从 75.76 A 降到 50.51 A，线路损耗和电源容量都随之减小。

en.title: Power-factor correction: find C
statement: An inductive load on a U = 220 V (rms), f = 50 Hz supply absorbs P = 10 kW at a power factor cos φ₁ = 0.6 (lagging).

A capacitor C is connected across the load to raise the power factor at the source to cos φ₂ = 0.9 (still lagging). Find the load current, the reactive power the capacitor must supply, the required capacitor (as a reactance) and the source current after correction.

questions.explain: I_Z = P/(U cos φ₁) = 10000/(220 × 0.6) ≈ 75.76 A. The parallel capacitor does not change the load voltage, so the load current is the same before and after correction.

questions.ask: Reactive power absorbed by the capacitor, Q_C = ?
questions.explain: Before: Q₁ = P tan φ₁ = 10000 × 4/3 = 13333 var; after: Q₂ = P tan φ₂ = 10000 × 0.4843 = 4843 var; Q_C = Q₂ − Q₁ = −P(tan φ₁ − tan φ₂) ≈ −8490 var.

questions.ask: Reactance of the required capacitor, X_C = 1/(ωC) = ? (C follows from it)
rms source current after correction, I = ?
questions.explain: P is unchanged: I = P/(U cos φ₂) = 10000/(220 × 0.9) ≈ 50.51 A — a third less than the 75.76 A before correction.

hints: A parallel capacitor changes neither the load's voltage, current nor real power P — only the reactive power the source must supply.
The reactive power before and after is P tan φ₁ and P tan φ₂; the capacitor supplies the difference.
solution: **1. Load current.** I_Z = P/(U cos φ₁) = 10000/132 ≈ **75.76 A** (before correction this is also the source current).
Q₁ = P tan φ₁ ≈ 13333 var, Q₂ = P tan φ₂ ≈ 4843 var, so the capacitor absorbs Q_C = Q₂ − Q₁ ≈ **−8490 var** (it supplies 8490 var).
**4. Source current.** I = P/(U cos φ₂) ≈ **50.51 A**.
Why correct the power factor: the load works exactly as before, but the line current drops from 75.76 A to 50.51 A, reducing line losses and the required source rating.
